steps.heading: How ordering with Packio works
steps.chooseBody: Pick the type, size, material and quantity and see the price and production date at once, or request a quote for something special
steps.designBody: Design on the real flat sheet or upload your file, then check the proof and approve it before production

design.title: Design or upload a file

price.title: Price and delivery date at once

proof.title: Approve the proof
proof.body: Every job is proofed before production, revised until it is right.

track.title: Track it to your door
track.body: See every stage from production to delivery.
